Our Story

Beauty Crafted with Passion

✦

LuxeGlow Studio was born from a vision — to create a sanctuary in the heart of Makati where exceptional beauty artistry meets serene, Instagram-worthy luxury. Every detail of our space and service has been curated for the discerning client who deserves the very best.

✄

Master Stylists & Nail Artists

Our team of internationally trained professionals brings world-class technique and artistry to every service.

◈

Luxurious Ambiance

Designed for the modern connoisseur — our space is as photogenic as it is serene, a true escape from the city.

❋

Premium Products Only

We exclusively use Olaplex, Kérastase, OPI, and more for stunning, lasting results every time.

Common Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

You can book through this page, call us at +63 917 123 4567, or message us on Instagram or Facebook. We recommend booking 2–3 days in advance, especially for weekends.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before your appointment. Cancellations within 24 hours may incur a 20% fee. Bridal packages require 48 hours notice.
Standard appointments require no deposit. For Bridal Luxe packages and group bookings of 3+, a 30% deposit is required via GCash, bank transfer, or credit card.
We use Schwarzkopf, Olaplex, Kérastase and Wella for hair; OPI, Gelish, and CND Shellac for nails. All are professional-grade and non-toxic.
Our keratin treatment lasts 3–5 months depending on your hair type and wash frequency. Use sulfate-free shampoo to extend results.
We accept cash, GCash, Maya, Visa, Mastercard, and bank transfers. A receipt is issued for every transaction.
Yes! Our VIP Membership includes priority booking, 10% off all services, monthly complimentary add-ons, and early access to promos. Ask us on your next visit.
